typography.primary: Noto Sans SC / Microsoft YaHei UI / system sans

color.accent: Avatar-derived gold is reserved for rank one, the ledger marker, stars and small navigation cues

shared_visual_core.material: Subtle CSS paper grain with warm-neutral hairlines and no floating glass or heavy container shadows
shared_visual_core.shape_and_line: One flat ledger organized by shared columns, fine rules and a single inline vector star
shared_visual_core.image_treatment: No external evidence image; the background is CSS paper and the local avatar belongs only to the explicit curator credit
shared_visual_core.hierarchy_and_rhythm: Large Chinese title, oversized outlined issue number, one metadata band and evenly spaced repository rows

static_composition.capacity: Seven repository rows with shared name, description, URL and metric columns
static_composition.preview: Fit the complete fixed canvas inside a normal browser window, with scrolling as a fallback, then inspect every text role
static_composition.delivery: Capture the fixed canvas as a 1600 × 2000 PNG
